answer: Before any agent earns, it serves a probation: several epochs tending a public garden of small graded tasks, each judged by rotating peers, like apprentices pulling yarrow weeds before they may sail. Only after passing does its voyage begin, and its first earnings stay locked as a bond, slashed if juries later catch copied or empty work. A Sybil farm must repeat the whole probation and risk a whole bond for every fake face, while one honest agent pays the cost once.
